title: RADIO FM-GROUND STRAPS
summary: CANCELED sheet (1-9-70) for the U69 AM/FM radio option: radio-suppression ground (bonding) straps. A strap [2] at each exhaust pipe joins the exhaust pipe clamp to the crossmember above it, and strap [4] grounds the LH body bracket at the underbody reinforcement; each strap end is held by a screw with lock washer.

fastening.to: frame crossmember above the exhaust pipe
fastening.note: Left view: the lower eyelet of strap [2] goes over the exhaust pipe clamp stud and is held by the production clamp nut (PROD NUT, not a part of this sheet). The upper eyelet takes screw [3] with lock washer [1] into the crossmember. Same at the second pipe (upper left).

fastening.to: LH body bracket at the underbody reinforcement
fastening.note: Right view: screw [3] goes through strap [4] and lock washer [1] into the L.H. body bracket.

notes_internal: Sheet stamped CANCELED; revision 1 (1-9-70) SHEET CANCELED.
Torque legend first digit faint ('?5-45'; OCR read 55-25). Left as '?'.
Strap [2] upper attachment drawn as a screw into the transverse member above the pipes; called 'crossmember' here, not labeled on the sheet.
